system.description:
In a Surprise Round, if you are not Surprised, you can take a Swift Action in addition to the one other Action normally allowed. If you are Surprised, you can take a single Swift Action.

Normal: In a Surprise Round, if you are not Surprised, you can take a Standard Action, a Move Action, or a Swift Action. If you are Surprised, you can take no Actions.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
